title: Officer
description: The frontmatter of an officer file: who a standing seat of the cockpit is, the commander or the pilot, as against the crew who come and go. Filed by name in the officer's own quarters, identity.md, job.md, commander.md.

type.description: the word Officer, which is what chooses this schema

unit.description: the officer's seat name, commander or pilot; an officer carries a name, not an identifier

stamp.description: three items: the date as YYYY-MM-DD, who wrote it, and the eight-character session id

context.description: the identifiers that settled what this file says, a bracketed list of orders and decisions
